8218.title: Unbounded GitHub mention database reads
8218.rootCauseOneLine: Mention search materializes every matching open cache row and sorts a table scan before slicing to eight suggestions.

prReviews.verdict: Static only: targets the observed cause; branch not executed.

8218.proposedFix: Bound mention SQL results and add a kind/state/update-time index while preserving full-list callers.
8218.caveats: Provider-level synthetic reproduction, not browser input. Original absolute timings and after-fix performance not verified. Existing PR #8219 prevents a duplicate fix.
